g.text: Database schema — as built (portable: PostgreSQL 16 after V3, MySQL 8.4 from V1)
Rule: at most one ACTIVE allocation per job
active_job_id = job_id when ACTIVE, else NULL
UPDATE and DELETE rejected by triggers
entity_id has no FK on purpose:
the trail outlives the rows it describes
Before (PostgreSQL V1): skills were text[] columns
V3 moved them here with their order kept.
Users are not linked by FK to
is recorded as text at that moment.
